# Grid Container

## Summary
A layout wrapper that arranges items as a grid or a list and yields each one its own container.

## Shape
More than a `display: grid` wrapper: `@items` with `@viewFormat` (`list` or `grid`) switches
arrangement, `@size` takes a `FittedFormatId` so the cells match a known fitted footprint, and
the block yields both the item and a `GridItemContainer` component to wrap it in.
`@fullWidthItem` lets one entry span the row. Consuming it is what stops cards re-declaring
grid gaps with slightly different numbers — the spacing comes from theme tokens.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/grid-container/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { GridContainer } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
